blueprint_sources: Atherton custom spec home — 6,000 sqft, radiant hydronic floors, 600A service, Lutron whole-home automation
Hillsborough luxury rebuild — steel frame cantilevers, linear slot diffusers, boiler room + chiller plant
Marin County contemporary — green roof, greywater recycling, 800A service with full-home battery backup

petronus_classification.note: High-end custom homes are defined by concealment of all mechanical systems. Linear slot diffusers, radiant floors, and smart-home integration are baseline expectations. The generator must size for massive power demands (400-800A), full hydronic heating, and fully hidden HVAC distribution. Aesthetic perfection drives every MEP routing decision.

lot.note: Large parcels with generous setbacks. Extensive landscaping. Ground-level equipment placement in side yards or mechanical buildings is feasible but must be screened and noise-compliant.

structure.radiant_tubing_note: Post-tensioned or structural slab carries hydronic tubing. Tubing layout must be coordinated with structural engineer before pour — tubing zones and structural tendons must not conflict.
structure.structural_note: Large open spans and cantilevers require steel moment frame or engineered wood beams. Coordinate MEP routing with structural system before design development — deep steel beams can block traditional MEP runs.

floor_program.note: Generous program with specialized rooms. Public entertaining areas on main floor, private suites on upper floors, wellness and service on lower level or wing.

floor_0.mep_note: Linear slot diffusers at all ceiling planes — no visible registers. Radiant floor heating in all rooms including kitchen. Chef kitchen has high-flow multi-head fixtures requiring flow calculations. Wine cellar requires dedicated mechanical cooling (not tied to main HVAC).

floor_1.mep_note: All baths have high-flow showers — calculate GPM demand for simultaneous operation. Hot water recirculation loop required to eliminate wait times. Lutron/Control4 dimming and shade control rough-in at every room.

lower_level_optional.mep_note: Dedicated mechanical/boiler room at this level. Steam room and sauna require dedicated electrical circuits (240V, typically 30-60A each). AV/IT room requires dedicated 20A circuits and structured wiring home run.

wet_wall.note: Unlike production homes, wet walls may be distributed throughout the plan to achieve optimal room placement. Hot water recirculation loop is mandatory to eliminate wait times at distant fixtures. Greywater recycling system routes shower/sink grey waste to landscape irrigation cistern.

staircase.mep_note: Grand stair is a centerpiece — no exposed MEP near stair. All vertical MEP must be concealed in dedicated chases remote from stair. Run low-voltage wiring for integrated lighting within stair stringers and treads.

mep_chase.boiler_room_note: Dedicated mechanical/boiler room minimum 80 sqft required. Houses: condensing hydronic boiler (or multiple), buffer tanks, distribution manifolds, zone valves, heat pump for cooling, snowmelt controls if applicable.
mep_chase.slot_diffuser_note: All supply air delivered via concealed linear slot diffusers in ceiling planes — no standard round or rectangular visible registers anywhere in finished spaces. Return air via continuous low-wall grilles or undercut doors.
mep_chase.note: Every MEP run must be in a dedicated concealed chase or the floor/ceiling assembly. No exposed conduit, pipe, or ductwork anywhere in finished spaces.

hvac.radiant_note: Radiant hydronic floor heating is primary heating source. Water tubes embedded in slab or topping slab circulate from dedicated boiler in mechanical room. Each room is a separate zone with individual thermostatic control.

dwv.high_flow_shower_note: Multi-head showers require flow rate calculation. A 3-head rain shower + 2 body sprays + 1 hand shower can draw 10-25 GPM — verify water supply pressure and pipe sizing before specifying fixtures.

supply.recirculation_loop_note: Dedicated hot water recirculation pump and return loop to water heater. Instant hot water at all fixtures. Loop must be insulated — no exposed recirculation pipe.

water_heater.capacity_note: Luxury home simultaneous fixture demand may exceed 15 GPM hot water. Specify multiple tankless units in series or commercial-grade heat pump water heater (80-120 gal). Coordinate with boiler system for heating integration.

greywater.note: Greywater recycling optional but increasingly expected in luxury spec market. Requires separate grey drain piping (not combined with black waste) and cistern with UV filtration for irrigation.

panel.battery_note: Whole-home battery backup (Tesla Powerwall or equivalent — multiple units) required. Size for minimum 2-day essential load operation. Battery room or outdoor cabinet with dedicated conditioned space.
panel.av_it_room_note: Dedicated AV/IT room or equipment closet with 2-post or 4-post rack, active cooling, UPS, and structured wiring home runs from every room.

ev_charging.note: 3-car garage: one 80A circuit per stall. Future-proof for Level 2 EVSE in each stall simultaneously.

solar.note: Large roof area on luxury homes enables significant PV generation. Green roof sections possible on flat areas — coordinate solar and green roof zones in roof plan.

massing_hints.note: Contemporary luxury massing — large horizontal planes, cantilevered volumes, floor-to-ceiling glass. Natural stone and hardwood cladding. Motor court at entry. Landscape integrated with architecture. No visible mechanical equipment anywhere.

known_constraints_summary: Hidden linear slot diffusers REQUIRED throughout — no standard visible registers in any finished space. Route all supply air through fully concealed plenum/chase system.
Radiant hydronic floor heating requires dedicated boiler room (80 sqft min) — NOT just an attic furnace. Coordinate hydronic tubing layout with structural slab design before pour.
400-800A electrical service — contact PG&E/utility service planning well in advance (lead times 4-12 months for 600A+ service).
Whole-home battery backup required — installed day one. Size for 2-day essential load. Dedicated battery room or outdoor enclosure.
Smart-home low-voltage rough-in: Cat6a home-run to every room from AV/IT room. Lutron/Control4/Crestron rough-in at every switch location.
Multi-head shower flow rates: calculate GPM demand before sizing supply mains — can easily reach 20+ GPM simultaneous draw.
Instant hot water recirculation loop required — insulated return loop from all fixture clusters back to mechanical room.
Cast iron DWV drains for acoustic attenuation — wrap all drain lines in mass-loaded vinyl where they pass through floor assemblies.
Greywater system (if selected) requires separate grey drain piping from day one — cannot retrofit without opening all walls.
Large open spans and cantilevers require steel moment frame — coordinate with structural engineer before MEP routing design.
